cohort: Babies diagnosed with congenital anomalies born to women who delivered after 12 weeks of gestation at a tertiary care hospital over a one-year period.
finding: Congenital anomalies were noted in 7.3 per 1,000 live births, with central nervous system (CNS) anomalies being the most common (42.5%), predominantly neural tube defects like anencephaly.
gest_age: Greater than 12 weeks of gestation; 54% of cases were 12-28 weeks
